name: Kentucky 4-H Teen Conference
org: University of Kentucky Cooperative Extension, Kentucky 4-H
what_you_do: A four-day leadership event for Kentucky 4-H teens.
who_can_apply: Kentucky 4-H teens in 8th grade and up (2026 listing). Sign up through your county Extension office.
deadline_text: 2026 conference was June 2 to 5. Registration closed April 15, 2026. The page does not give 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Conference Registration Form. Turn it in to your county Extension office by the deadline. You must be in Kentucky 4-H through 4-H Online.
notes: Details come from the Meade County Extension listing for the state event. The Kentucky 4-H leadership page names the Teen Conference but gives no details. Scholarships are not mentioned there; ask your county office.
